examples.english: This is also the case in the therapeutic relationship (therapist-client/analysand, which refers us to the "transference love" Freud spoke of), in the learning relationship (teacher/student) and in the spiritual relationship (teacher/disciple), when these are deep.
examples.ref: 2019, Albert Rams, Músicas para un viaje interior, Plataforma, →ISBN, page 112:
examples.text: También sucede así en la relación terapéutica (terapeuta-cliente/analizante, lo que nos remite al «amor de transferencia» del que hablaba Freud), en la de aprendizaje (profesor/alumnx) y en la espiritual (maestrx/discípulx), cuando estas son profundas.
examples.translation: This is also the case in the therapeutic relationship (therapist-client/analysand, which refers us to the "transference love" Freud spoke of), in the learning relationship (teacher/student) and in the spiritual relationship (teacher/disciple), when these are deep.

examples.english: Today it is conceivable that a family member questions any limit or qualification set by a teacher, it is even conceivable that they threaten or hit a teacher if they do not agree with a measure taken with respect to their child.
examples.ref: 2021, Liliana Maltz, Vaivenes de la ternura. ESI en el Nivel Inicial, Noveduc, →ISBN, page 49:
examples.text: Hoy es pensable que un familiar cuestione cualquier límite o calificación puestos por unx docente, incluso es pensable que amenace o golpee a unx maestrx si no acuerda con una medida tomada respecto de su hijx.
examples.translation: Today it is conceivable that a family member questions any limit or qualification set by a teacher, it is even conceivable that they threaten or hit a teacher if they do not agree with a measure taken with respect to their child.

examples.english: For example, in the area of social sciences, a sixth grade teacher is developing the time of the Viceroyalty of the River Plate and introduces the gender approach to think about the activities and clothing of women and men in the colony and compare them with today.
examples.ref: 2021, Susana Beatriz Gamba, Tania Diz, Nuevo diccionario de estudios de género y feminismos, Editorial Biblos, →ISBN, page 299:
examples.text: Por ejemplo, en el área de ciencias sociales unx maestrx de sexto grado está desarrollando la época del Virreinato del Río de la Plata e introduce el enfoque de género para pensar actividades y vestimentas de mujeres y varones en la colonia y compararlas con la actualidad.
examples.translation: For example, in the area of social sciences, a sixth grade teacher is developing the time of the Viceroyalty of the River Plate and introduces the gender approach to think about the activities and clothing of women and men in the colony and compare them with today.

glosses: teacher
